description:
Execute a structured query plan over your encrypted knowledge graph. Returns STRUCTURE ONLY
    (node_type, name_hash, relationships, chunk_ids, timestamps) — never content.

    Plan schema:
      {
        "entity_filters": [{"node_type": <type>} | {"name_hash": <sha256-hex>}],
        "edge_filters":   [{"relationship": <rel>, "direction": "out"|"in"|"both"}],
        "temporal_bounds":{"valid_from_after": <ISO8601>, "valid_to_before": <ISO8601>},
        "limit": <int <= 200>,
        "include_neighbours_depth": <0-5>
      }
    node_type in {entity, concept, decision, person, organisation, event, source, synthesis}.
    relationship in {references, contradicts, supports, supersedes, caused_by, related_to,
    part_of, informed_by, led_to, verifies}. Account scope is enforced server-side; it cannot be
    set from the plan.

include_chunks.description: Also return the chunk ids behind each node. Default false.
include_chunks.title: Include Chunks

plan.description: The structured query plan (a JSON object): entity_filters [{node_type} | {name_hash}], edge_filters [{relationship, direction out|in|both}], temporal_bounds {valid_from_after, valid_to_before} (ISO 8601), limit (<= 200), include_neighbours_depth (0-5). The schema and the allowed node_type / relationship values are in this tool's description.
plan.title: Plan

name: query_memory
